{
  "summary": "Parikh et al. propose a decomposable attention model for natural language inference that aligns local text substructures via attention, solves subproblems separately, and aggregates information without relying on word order. The model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SNLI with significantly fewer parameters than complex LSTM-based approaches.",
  "limitations": "",
  "approach": "attention-based alignment",
  "evaluation": "SNLI corpus",
  "abstract": "The decomposable attention model aligns local text substructures via attention to solve NLI subproblems separately, enabling trivially parallelizable computation with fewer parameters than deep models.",
  "introduction": "Parikh et al. introduce a decomposable attention model for natural language inference that processes premise and hypothesis sentence pairs.",
  "conclusion": "The decomposable attention model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SNLI with almost an order of magnitude fewer parameters than prior work."
}
